titles:
Windmills
An Expanding Collection, 1998, Georgia O'Keeffe Museum (Santa Fe)

description: Small horizontal watercolor of windmills, two of which are situated on the right.  The darker one in the foreground has a water tower beneath it.  The second windmill on the right is much lighter and smaller in the background.  On the left is the silhouette of another windmill in the distance with the suggestion of buildings behind it.  All on a yellow ground with large cumulus cloud in the middle left.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Tim Nighswander/IMAGING4ART
